title: Direct image of pro-etale module sheaves
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $A$ be a commutative ring. Use the small pro-etale sites $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, their size convention, the constant sheaves of rings $A_X$, $A_Y$, and the categories $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ of sheaves of modules [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the morphism of sites and the constant-ring structure map of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]: its base-change functor is
$$
 u_f:Y_{\mathrm{proet}}\longrightarrow X_{\mathrm{proet}},\qquad (V\to Y)\longmapsto(V\times_YX\to X),
$$
which carries coverings to coverings and commutes with fibre products, and its ring map $\rho^f_A:A_Y\to f_*A_X$ extends the map of constant presheaves $a\mapsto a|_{V\times_YX}$ by sheafification.

For a sheaf $F$ of $A_X$-modules, define its direct image by
$$
 (f_*F)(V)=F(V\times_YX).
$$
The restrictions are those of $F$ along $u_f$. Its underlying abelian presheaf is the direct-image sheaf of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Give it the $A_Y$-module structure
$$
 A_Y(V)\times F(V\times_YX)\longrightarrow F(V\times_YX),\qquad (a,s)\longmapsto\rho^f_{A,V}(a)s.
$$
Here module sheaves and their morphisms have the sectionwise meaning of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. On morphisms put $(f_*\varphi)_V=\varphi_{V\times_YX}$. Restriction compatibility and the module axioms are the corresponding equalities for $F$ after substitution along $u_f$ and restriction of scalars along $\rho^f_A$; the components of $f_*\varphi$ are $A_Y(V)$-linear since $\varphi_{V\times_YX}$ is $A_X(V\times_YX)$-linear. Identities, composition and addition of morphisms are computed componentwise, so these assignments define an additive functor
$$
 f_*:\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\longrightarrow\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A).
$$

Source for this construction: Stacks Project, proetale.tex, Tag 09A5 (label proetale-section-morphism), introductory paragraph; sites-modules.tex, Tag 03D6 (label sites-modules-definition-pushforward), clause (1). Tag 03D7 is the adjunction lemma, not the definition of pushforward.

lean.note: §1(B), H13 repair: lowerStar is the fixed-scalar presentation, whereas this item uses intrinsic constant-ring module sheaves. The previous proposed sfConstantModuleDirectImage rebind incorrectly required [Finite A], which the dependency does not assume. The existing proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage has only [CommRing A] and defines exactly the intrinsic sectionwise pushforward by SheafOfModules.pushforward along proEtaleBaseChange, restricting scalars through the canonical proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageMap rho. Thus it covers arbitrary commutative rings, including infinite rings, with no added geometric or finiteness hypothesis.
